1  
 orders on the appeal-cum-legal notice made by the petitioner dated  07.09.2022 for enhancement of compensation and dispose of the same   accordance with law at an early date.
For Petitioner : Mr.C.Prabakaran  For R1 and R3 : Mr.D.Ravichander  Special Government   For R2 : Mr.Su.Srinivasan  ORDER

The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the National Highways/second respondent made a submission that the petitioner has not submitted an appropriate application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act.
2.The legal notice cannot be considered as an application within the provisions of the Act.
Thus the petitioner is at liberty to submit an appropriate application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act.
On receipt of any such application from the petitioner, the same shall be considered on merits and in accordance with law and by following the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis provisions of the Act.
3.With these observations, the writ petition stands disposed of.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
